body:
Restore the current root suite and require GitHub's existing `invariants` check before merges to main. At starting commit `b9cafd196b1d8f8b74b207320836532c14e78bab`, 1,853 root tests produced 19 failures and 11 errors: 29 came from stale law bindings and one from the package cap. The full baseline passed 33 of 35 checks; #1520 supplied the additional Hexaemeron failure.

Closes wildcat-finance/skills#1538

The delivery stack is merged and canonical ADR allocation is complete on the integration candidate. The final merge to main and final main `invariants` result remain pending. Completion requires the passing check for the exact published main commit.

## Repair and enforcement

- Step 1's selected `absolute-refresh` design moves all four unchanged reviewed law slices by 4,412 bytes, preserving their meanings and the v1 codec. Three local profiles were reviewed before new complete 10-call measurement and 36-call parity cohorts were acquired. The refused first parity cohort remains preserved.
- The portable package omits 32 decorative portraits and repairs 47 packaged Markdown image references while retaining all 34 source portraits. The manifest records exact omissions and removed byte ranges. Eleven unchanged prompts permit owner replay of historical evaluation answers with their original model and date; that replay is no new model observation.
- At the recorded product head, the complete package uses 18,668,573 bytes across 1,402 files, with 7,545,827 bytes of headroom below the fixed 26,214,400-byte cap. Runtime payload is 18,239,372 bytes across 1,395 files. Both retain the required 5,242,880-byte reserve. Fresh Step 2 offline corpus, package and installed-evaluation checks accepted the preserved evidence without new model calls.
- #1520's test now checks `run_observation_binding.controller` separately from the six runtime test-source bindings, as its issue accepts. #1542's two CLI tests use their own candidate records and source copies. Production fallback is inherited; Warden's bypass probe stayed green, so no new isolation guard is claimed.
- Applied protection requires `invariants` from GitHub Actions app `15368`, `strict: true` and administrator enforcement. Red [PR #1547](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1547) changed from `unstable` to `blocked` while its required check remained `FAILURE`; no merge was attempted. The rejected HTTP 422 request and corrected accepted request are preserved. Existing workflow triggers were already sufficient and remain unchanged.

The [recovery records](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/3d3a6a9f7f1519912d59b45444fb64124b9ba70e/docs/main-root-suite-recovery/README.md) hold the study, amended runbook, selected design, profile review, reproduction commands and [demonstration](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/3d3a6a9f7f1519912d59b45444fb64124b9ba70e/docs/main-root-suite-recovery/demonstration.md). Canonical allocation assigns `adr/omit-portable-decorative-portraits` to ADR-090. PR #1515 and its existing controller remain a separate specification effort.

## Validation and review

Step 1 implementation `0578c19bb812ba34fcfc752dcb81e5df4b1090ae` passed 1,882 active root tests, 2,615 Hexaemeron tests, the 403-test focused runner and all 35 declared checks. Warden independently passed 1,882 root tests, 403 focused tests and all 35 checks on its recorded audit tree.

Step 2 implementation `dcb4e57fc947fd39fb27f65aaf36b6db0bc328e9`, tree `00215f0f7460a63a71944f0661dc577c0faf087d`, passed 1,882 active root tests, 2,615 Hexaemeron tests and all 35 checks with 12 slots. Full report SHA-256: `b1204e68607b018e5c32d2cbfc89f85815df6e2fec7a88159058f25973403582`. The disposable root run skipped its active-checkout hook assertion; the active root and genuine staged gate had zero skips.

[Audit PR #1549](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1549) and [audit PR #1552](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1552) remain unmerged review artefacts, separate from the merged [Step 1 delivery PR #1550](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1550) and [Step 2 delivery PR #1553](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1553). The [audit log](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/b62fff15a695b5428d1269edb1b3616bbb7a1a8d/audit/rounds/fiat-1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m.md) records one round per step, each with 0 findings, no fixes and Elenchus verdict `null`. Step 2 Warden freshly passed 1,882 active root tests and the 1,882-test staged gate with no failures, errors or skips; three discipline lints exited 0. It independently reread protection and the blocked red PR and checked Mason's full report. It made no new full run, package build or model calls.

The Step 2 delivery head `3d3a6a9f7f1519912d59b45444fb64124b9ba70e` and audit record commit `b62fff15a695b5428d1269edb1b3616bbb7a1a8d` carry identical checked tree `7129117eb6285ee1b0facfe433c8ec95625b3df1`. These product checks remain bound to their recorded heads. The integration checks below cover the composed candidate separately; neither establishes final main CI.

```bash
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python scripts/agent_instruction.py check --root . --manifest tests/fixtures/agent-instruction-v1/manifest.json
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python tests/emit_main_root_recovery_report.py .elenchus/main-root-recovery.json
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python -m unittest discover -s tests
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python plugins/hexaemeron/tests/run_tests.py
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python scripts/run_checks.py --full --jobs 12 --format json --report .hexaemeron/full-completion-checks.json
```

## Integration and sibling acceptance

Both delivery PRs merged into the run branch in order: Step 1 PR #1550 at `3a9f27b7bccde04f4da7e789923258524de3373c`, then Step 2 PR #1553 at `f88b3c60d054e8691dd60f34a307bb2640dd1521`. Each passed hosted `report` and `invariants` checks before its merge. The run branch is `fiat/1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m`, targeting `main`; its starting base is `b9cafd196b1d8f8b74b207320836532c14e78bab`. Step 2's branch was `fiat/1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m-step-2-demonstrate-recovery-and-require`, based on `fiat/1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m-step-1-scaffold-recovery-and-restore-al` at `c7db7d734fad5ab40511ae04cbb8a6c43aefb824`.

The final integration candidate is `f5dec5b560122de91aaaf4acd3ac3e40d30b1e4e`, tree `5f48caffde9c41846e13dfdda5c5f10165d3e274`, with ordered parents `f88b3c60d054e8691dd60f34a307bb2640dd1521` and `b9cafd196b1d8f8b74b207320836532c14e78bab`. The main base remains that starting commit.

Canonical report `.hexaemeron/decision-assignments.json`, SHA-256 `29a1ce99f82719b36e2621641647a1d043073d9102133dcad1b68bc6af236f96`, assigns the inherited `adr/keep-a-constant-template-literal-outside-e001` draft to ADR-089 and the package decision to ADR-090. Allocator replay and the controller's `verify-decision-assignments` accepted the signed candidate. The six-path delta from the last step merge contains only the two canonical Markdown moves and heading changes, the package decision's owner path in `tests/check-map-v1.json`, and generated `.horos/census.json`. Markdown loses 2 bytes and the map gains 1 byte, for a net reduction of 1 byte.

The genuine staged gate passed 1,882 root tests on tree `5f48caffde9c41846e13dfdda5c5f10165d3e274`; Phylax, Ephoros, Hypomnema, Imprimatur and canonical replay exited 0 on their named integration inputs. The integration runner used `--base f88b3c60d054e8691dd60f34a307bb2640dd1521 --jobs 12`; the changed check map selected all 35 checks, and all 35 passed with exit 0 on the exact clean signed candidate. Report `.hexaemeron/integration/checks.json` has SHA-256 `38fd45530548db22bdb08ca1cecaf9f394390e018d27f0b654f42f6a42027805`; its terminal proof binds that report to candidate `f5dec5b560122de91aaaf4acd3ac3e40d30b1e4e` and tree `5f48caffde9c41846e13dfdda5c5f10165d3e274`.

#1467's omission, reference-repair and headroom criteria have independent proof. #1520's accepted binding semantics and #1542's concrete test isolation are delivered in the product. Their completion comments and closures await final integration and passing final main CI. The parent completed canonical ADR allocation; #1267's inherited format conflict remains unresolved. The signed candidate preserves both provenance lines immediately before its ADR-only final block.

## Carried forward

Issue #1513 retains the reusable reconciliation API after the immediate corpus repair; #1192 retains relative offsets. #1198 retains guard attribution, #1199 acquisition-output and token-count assurance, #1200 design-report and placement limits, and #1267 the ADR/provenance format conflict. These issues remain open.
